source_shape: bone-weighted source mesh regions reduced to convex support hulls
motion: 2 s authored torso turn and forearm pose; no walking
sampling_policy: clothing_candidate is geometry annotation, not automatic permission to touch
limitations: Rigid convex regions; not deformable skin or clothing
Hands are whole-hand hulls, not finger-level contact
Kinematic bodies do not react like a dynamic human
MuJoCo visual snapshot is static; USD animates skin and colliders together
Mass, contact friction and human-contact force limits are not calibrated
